listing.name: Killzone — KillzoneRecomp-Extended (Tzeentchnet)
listing.summary: Test build. Upstream reports boot, movies, profile selection, first-mission gameplay, Quit/Continue/load and timing/input checks. Later 14/14 ISO-free checks concern harness coverage, not campaign completion. Intermittent combat effects/dialogue truncation remains AUDIO-01. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own NTSC-U Killzone disc ISO, serial SCUS-97402; local generation additionally requires extracted SCUS_974.02 ELF. Exact accepted ELF/ISO hash and revision are Unknown in this narrow retained README review.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Documented Windows source route: provision locked dependencies, generate code from own ELF, build own runtime and package a player folder. README calls it a test build; public prebuilt release availability was not queried.
